messages:
Sofia (Finance): Morning — our nightly GPU ledger shows an $18.3k charge posted to team tag `infra:shared` for yesterday 02:00 UTC. This looks like it should belong to `research-rl`. Can someone confirm if allocation mapping changed after the tagging roll? Link: https://files.internal/ledger/176945 (redacted)
Ibrahim (FinOps): Saw same. On it. Do we have the raw ingestion job logs? Suspect mapping table `gpu_pool_map` got a new rule: prefix 'shared-' -> infra:shared.
Matt (Infra): We rolled a rename last week `shared-infra` -> `infra-shared` to normalize. That could break pattern-based maps. Sorry, didn't flag billing impact. :grimacing: 
Devon (Platform): Tagging pipeline uses regex `^shared` to map to infra:shared. If name flipped to `infra-shared` it won't match. We should backfill and then run reclassification job. I can trigger reclass for last 7 days.
Sofia (Finance): Thanks. Need confirmed counts and cost delta before EOD. Budget owners (cc @Ara) need heads-up.
Ara (AI Research): That's the RL team's burst. If we reclass, can you make sure the commit history keeps the original request id? We need to tie to the customer project for chargebacks.
Ibrahim (FinOps): Plan: 1) snapshot current unassigned charges 2) run dry-run reclass job 3) produce CSV of candidate rows and deltas 4) apply after approvals. I'll prepare the CSV.
Matt (Infra): Quick fix: revert the rename on the mapping service or add additional regex. I can push a small hotfix to accept both `^shared` and `infra-?shared`.
Devon (Platform): Hotfix sounds right to avoid future misses, but we still need backfill.
Sofia (Finance): Ibrahim, please include columns: original_pool, observed_pool_name, timestamp, cost_usd, suggested_tag, project_id. Put in /finance/allocations/ for review.
Ibrahim (FinOps): Will do, uploading preliminary CSV now — https://files.internal/allocs/176945_prelim.csv
billing-bot: alert: reclassification job queued (job_id: rc-176945-01). ETA ~12m. Status: initiated.
Matt (Infra): ETA for regex patch ~20m. Will keep it separate from backfill.
Devon (Platform): Ibrahim, can you also include the k-v cache id for the requests so we can verify no double-charge?
Ibrahim (FinOps): Added kv_cache_id column in v0.2. Doing dry-run now.
Sofia (Finance): If numbers are >$5k reclassified, we'll need manager sign-off (per policy). Ibrahim ping me once you have the summary.
Ara (AI Research): FYI RL lead will approve once they see mapping to their project id.
Ibrahim (FinOps): Dry-run finished. Summary: $3,412 reclass from infra:shared -> research-rl for 2026-03-22 window. CSV: https://files.internal/allocs/176945-dryrun.csv
Sofia (Finance): That's under threshold. Proceed with backfill after Matt's hotfix. Please log PR/changes for audit.
Matt (Infra): Hotfix deployed to prod mapping service. Regex updated to `(?:^shared|infra-?shared|shared-.*)`. Rolling restarts on ingestion. No downtime.
billing-bot: reclassification job completed (job_id: rc-176945-01). Affected rows: 1,230. Total reclassified USD: 3,412. Job log: https://logs.internal/rc-176945-01
Ibrahim (FinOps): Applied reclass. CSV of applied rows: https://files.internal/allocs/176945-applied.csv. I've opened a chargeback ticket and scheduled night-run verification for 48h.
Sofia (Finance): Great. Action items: Matt create hotfix PR link for audit, Ibrahim attach manager approval thread, Devon verify no duplicate charges. I'll update budgets to reflect reclassification.
Devon (Platform): Verified no duplicates — KV dedupe check passed. Closing loop.
Ara (AI Research): Thanks team. Please cc RL billing contact on the ticket.
Sofia (Finance): Noted, filing to Jira FIN-4821 and adding RL contact. :white_check_mark:
